subject.title: Control UI fails to load on Firefox desktop behind reverse proxy — CSP blocks Vite runtime eval(), 'Control UI did not start', WebSocket 1006

question: Should this issue remain a separate Firefox reverse-proxy WebSocket 1006 investigation, or should maintainers fold it into the existing Control UI CSP/Zod issue while preserving strict CSP?
rationale: The CSP evidence overlaps an open security-sensitive issue, but this report adds a distinct Firefox/nginx reverse-proxy 1006 symptom that needs live proof before changing gateway WebSocket or CSP behavior.

options.title: Keep separate pending live proof
options.body: Keep this issue open for the Firefox reverse-proxy WebSocket failure while the shared Zod/CSP repair stays tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362.

options.title: Consolidate under CSP issue
options.body: Treat the WebSocket failure as likely startup fallout from blocked JavaScript and close or fold this into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362 after preserving the proxy details there.

options.title: Sponsor CSP fix first
options.body: Advance the strict-CSP Zod/jitless fix under the existing CSP issue, then ask for fresh reverse-proxy proof only if the socket failure remains.

recommendation.title: Keep separate pending live proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the Firefox reverse-proxy WebSocket failure while the shared Zod/CSP repair stays tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across Control UI CSP, bootstrap, secure auth, and gateway connect behavior.
